in_marathi.name: Prithvansh
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Earth
in_marathi.long_meaning: Prithvansh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Prithvi means earth and Ansh means soul or self. Together, it means the Lord of the Earth or the ruler of the Earth.

in_bengali.name: Prithvansh
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Lord of the Earth
in_bengali.long_meaning: Prithvansh একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। Prithvi means earth and Ansh means soul or self. Together, it means the Lord of the Earth or the ruler of the Earth.
